data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 Syndicate 6104 had opening gross claims outstanding of 139.629 million USD (prior year). The technical provisions note shows an adverse prior-year movement (under/over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses) of 22.18 million USD (strengthening), representing c.15.9% of opening gross reserves. The movement is primarily driven by re-estimation of prior catastrophe exposures (notably 2017 and 2018 hurricane and California wildfire events) on this property catastrophe quota-share reinsurance portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases:
Under/over-provision in respect of prior 
claims and claim adjustment expenses
These three hurricanes and wildfires were the only significant losses materially impacting the account.
The account has closed with a loss to capacity of 35.0% after all personal expenses (except member's agent's fees).
The 2017 account picked up almost all of the reinsurance loss from the 2017 hurricanes (Harvey, Irma, Maria) together with a share of direct property loss.
data.data_quality_notes: All source amounts are reported in the syndicate financial statements in US Dollars (reported as $000). Monetary fields have been converted to millions (USD) for the JSON. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) prior-year column. Prior-year movement taken from Technical provisions note row 'Under/over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (gross). Claims development triangle (gross) is available and was used as cross-check. Some event reserve amounts are presented as combined totals for multiple events in the underwriting accounts narrative; where combined amounts were given they were recorded as reported. No gross PYD net-of-reinsurance fallback was required.
